en: A black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with a small lake in the foreground, where a few waterfowl are swimming. Gentle grassy slopes and dense trees surround the water. At the top of the hill, partly hidden by foliage, stands a large historic-looking house or small manor with steep roofs and a small tower or spire. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image.
